body: **How to Declutter Before a Big Move** ====================================== **Meta Description:** Start your new life in a clutter-free home with our expert junk removal services. **Keywords:** decluttering, moving, junk removal, organization, home cleaning Are you preparing for a big move to a new home? If so, you're likely feeling overwhelmed by the thought of packing up your entire life and starting fresh. One of the most daunting tasks of moving is decluttering and removing unwanted items from your old home. In this article, we'll provide you with a comprehensive guide on how to declutter before a big move, making it easier to transition into your new life. **Step 1: Gather Supplies** --------------------------- Before you begin decluttering, make sure you have the right tools and supplies. Here are a few essentials to get you started: * **Reusable boxes**: Invest in sturdy, reusable boxes that can withstand multiple moves. You can also use cardboard boxes, but be sure to label them clearly. * **Label maker**: Labeling your boxes and rooms will save you time and stress in the long run. * **Trash bags**: You'll need these to dispose of unwanted items and packaging materials. * **Donation boxes**: Consider using separate boxes for items you want to donate or sell. ### Don't Have Time? Call Get a Free Quote from 1-800-GOT-JUNK? → If decluttering seems like too much to handle, consider hiring professionals from 1-800-GOT-JUNK? to take care of the hard work for you. **Step 2: Sort and Purge** ------------------------- Decluttering is all about sorting and purging. Here's a simple approach to help you get started: * **Start small**: Begin with one room at a time to avoid feeling overwhelmed. * **Sort items into categories**: Use the 4-box method: + **Keep**: Items you want to keep and use in your new home. + **Donate/Sell**: Items that are still in good condition but no longer needed. + **Recycle**: Items that can be recycled, such as paper, cardboard, and glass. + **Toss**: Items that are broken, damaged, or no longer useful. * **Be ruthless**: Be honest with yourself about each item. If you haven't used it in the past year, it's likely safe to get rid of it. ### What to Keep vs. What to Remove When deciding what to keep and what to remove, consider the following: * **Keep only what brings you joy**: A popular tip from Marie Kondo's KonMari method. * **Keep items with sentimental value**: Consider the memories associated with each item and whether it's worth holding onto. * **Keep only what serves a purpose**: Be honest about whether an item still serves a purpose in your life. **Step 3: Organize Your Belongings** -------------------------------- Once you've decluttered, it's time to organize your belongings. Here are a few tips to help you stay organized: * **Purge unnecessary packaging**: Remove any unnecessary packaging materials from your belongings. * **Use space-efficient storage**: Invest in storage solutions that maximize space, such as stackable containers and shelves. * **Keep frequently used items accessible**: Store frequently used items in easy-to-reach locations. ### Make Moving a Breeze By decluttering and organizing your belongings, you'll make moving a breeze.
